description: A man in a dark suit and tie sits in an airplane cabin, looking out an oval window at a harbor with palm trees, a few ships and calm water under a warm, hazy sky. He rests his hands on a dark leather satchel, with papers tucked in its flap. The cabin has patterned seat fabric, overhead panels and a mid-century airliner look. No visible text, numbers or signature. The painting runs edge to edge with no frame or wall. Nothing violent or nude.
